title: Tesla Stock News (Oct 12, 2026): TSLA Rises 2.1% to $382.70
summary: Tesla (TSLA) closed at $382.70 on Oct 9, up 2.05%, with no single reported cause; news centered on its Europe rename of Full Self-Driving.
body_markdown:
## Why Tesla Stock Rose


No published report tied Friday's gain directly to one company event, so the move is best read against the broader market's advance and the week's Tesla headlines. Two dated items stood out.


First, according to[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/tesla-drops-full-self-driving-104518889.html) , Tesla began renaming "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)" to "Tesla Assisted Driving" across its European websites from October 8. German Transport Minister Steffen Bilger said his goal was for Tesla drivers "to be able to use the benefits of Assisted Driving throughout the EU as quickly as possible," and the report noted that eight EU countries had approved the system. As reported by[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-renames-full-self-driving-051143113.html) , Germany's transport ministry had called the old name "somewhat misleading" because drivers must stay attentive.


Second, according to the company's[official October 2 release](https://www.financialcontent.com/article/bizwire-2026-10-2-tesla-third-quarter-2026-production-deliveries-and-deployments) , Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter of 2026, produced 464,391 and deployed 13.7 GWh of energy storage. Per[Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/forget-recent-delivery-beat-heres-210000651.html) , deliveries came in above Wall Street estimates.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 vehicles topped the prior quarter's 480,126, according to Motley Fool.
- Germany's public backing and eight national approvals give Tesla a clearer path for its driver-assistance software in Europe, per Benzinga.
- Energy storage deployments reached 13.7 GWh in the quarter, according to the company's release.


### Risks


- Motley Fool flags automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits as the number that will decide the earnings reaction, with management previously citing commodity costs and rising subvention costs as headwinds.
- Benzinga reports the EU-wide vote was pushed from October to at least December, with France and Sweden objecting to parts of Germany's position.
- TIKR notes the NHTSA is investigating how the software performs in poor visibility and around potential traffic violations.


Tesla is scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results after the market close on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, according to its release.
